<function name="Holster" parent="TOOL" type="hook">
	<description>Called when <page>WEAPON:Holster</page> of the toolgun is called, when switching between different toolguns.</description>
	<realm>Shared</realm>
	<predicted>Yes</predicted>
</function>

<example>
	<description>Clears any objects set by <page>Tool:SetObject</page>.</description>
	<code>
function TOOL:Holster()

	self:ClearObjects()

end
	</code>

</example>
